terms.holding: An owned financial or corporate position.
terms.share: One immutable unit of company ownership.
terms.ownership: The proportion of an asset controlled by an actor.
terms.dividend: A ledger-booked distribution to eligible shareholders.
terms.order_book: The authoritative list of open buy and sell orders.
terms.bid: A binding offer to buy or provide a service.
terms.bond: A fixed debt instrument issued by a company.
terms.loan: A ledger-backed principal with a repayment schedule.
terms.collateral: An asset pledged against an obligation.
terms.district: A controllable subdivision of a game city.
terms.cartel: A player organization for coordinated strategy.
terms.investigation: A server-resolved process for discovering information.
terms.world_event: A server-authoritative event affecting the shared world.
terms.season: A bounded competitive period with archived results.
terms.mastery: Evidence-based progress in a strategic discipline.
